thesis: Lord of the Pit embodied Alpha's bargain design: an enormous flying trampler offered ahead of curve, but demanded a creature every upkeep and punished failure with seven damage.

playbook.role: Supply repeatable tokens or expendable creatures before casting it, and plan for removal that might strand the upkeep cost. Sacrificing the Lord before the trigger resolves can be preferable to taking seven.
